title: Moyva — Generator Map Recipe
description: JSON source of truth для Kruty1918.Moyva.Generator.API.GeneratorMapRecipe. Згенеровано з фактичного Unity serialization contract; runtime читає JSON напряму.

id.title: Стабільний ID
id.description: Стабільний ідентифікатор. Використовуйте дефіси; ID не залежить від filename або C# class name.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: 0 = resolve seed from the launch context; non-zero pins this recipe's seed.

mapWidth.title: Map Width
mapWidth.description: Authoritative map width in tiles. 0 = runtime/menu decides.

mapHeight.title: Map Height
mapHeight.description: Authoritative map height in tiles. 0 = runtime/menu decides.

waterLikeTileIds.title: Water Like Tile Ids
waterLikeTileIds.description: Tile ID, які вважаються водою у всіх нодах генератора.

riverBaseObjectId.title: River Base Object Id
riverBaseObjectId.description: Базовий Object ID річки для всіх нод генератора.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Роздільник для базового типу (Object ID та Tile ID).

matchBaseTypes.title: Match Base Types
matchBaseTypes.description: Якщо увімкнено, порівнює базовий тип (до роздільника) замість точного ID.

sharedGeneratorSettings.title: Shared Generator Settings
sharedGeneratorSettings.description: Shared generator semantics (water-like tile ids, separators, ...).

preset.description: Opaque Unity asset reference. Gameplay values не зберігаються в Unity asset.
preset.title: Preset

tileVariants.title: Tile Variants
tileVariants.description: Weighted preset variants; overridden by TileType.Visual.Variants when set.

useDualGrid.title: Use Dual Grid
useDualGrid.description: If enabled, TWC uses Dual Grid. Enabled automatically for dual presets.

scaleTileToCellSize.title: Scale Tile To Cell Size
scaleTileToCellSize.description: Scale prefab tiles to the TWC cell size.

layerYOffset.title: Layer Y Offset
layerYOffset.description: Y offset of the whole build layer relative to BlueprintLayer.defaultLayerHeight.

tileLayerHeightOffset.title: Tile Layer Height Offset
tileLayerHeightOffset.description: Height offset of the first tile layer inside the TWC build layer.

ignoreFillTiles.title: Ignore Fill Tiles
ignoreFillTiles.description: Ignore fill tiles in the first tile layer.

tileBuild.title: Tile Build
tileBuild.description: Build-layer overrides used when TileType has no Visual config.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Ordered mask steps evaluated top-down to produce this layer's mask.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Ordered generator layers. Earlier layers are available as mask references to later ones.

layerName.title: Layer Name
layerName.description: Name of the generated TWC blueprint/build object layer.

targetLayerId.title: Target Layer Id
targetLayerId.description: Recipe layer whose final mask seeds the scatter. Empty = the owning layer.

exclusionLayerId.title: Exclusion Layer Id
exclusionLayerId.description: Optional recipe layer whose final mask excludes cells.

prefab.description: Prefab variant that can be spawned by this object layer.
prefab.title: Prefab

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Weighted random selection weight. Values are normalized by the TWC object layer.

yOffset.title: Y Offset
yOffset.description: Vertical offset applied through the generated TWC Object Build Layer.

materialOverride.description: Opaque Unity asset reference. Gameplay values не зберігаються в Unity asset.
materialOverride.title: Material Override

prefabs.title: Prefabs
prefabs.description: Prefab variants used by the generated TWC Object Build Layer.

mergeInTWC.title: Merge In TWC
mergeInTWC.description: Use TWC object cluster merge. Good for dense grass cards, bad for interactive prefabs.

useTWCObjectLayer.title: Use TWC Object Layer
useTWCObjectLayer.description: When enabled, graph output is converted to a generated TWC Object Build Layer.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: Scatter rules mapped into the generated TWC Object Build Layer.

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Cluster scatter settings; Enabled switches to cluster scatter.

texture.description: Opaque Unity asset reference. Gameplay values не зберігаються в Unity asset.
texture.title: Texture

material.description: Opaque Unity asset reference. Gameplay values не зберігаються в Unity asset.
material.title: Material

prefab.description: Opaque Unity asset reference. Gameplay values не зберігаються в Unity asset.
prefab.title: Prefab

grass.title: Grass
grass.description: Optional generated grass-card settings appended as a prefab variant.

objectPlacements.title: Object Placements
objectPlacements.description: Ordered object scatter passes evaluated after all layer masks.

quantumMeters.title: Quantum Meters
quantumMeters.description: Terrace height step in meters. 0.25 matches the atlas tile contract.

maxSteps.title: Max Steps
maxSteps.description: Number of terrace steps above the minimum field height.

heightExponent.title: Height Exponent
heightExponent.description: Exponent applied before terrace quantization. Values above 1 reserve high ground for peaks.

noiseScale.title: Noise Scale
noiseScale.description: Noise scale in cells — larger values produce wider plateaus.

smoothingIterations.title: Smoothing Iterations
smoothingIterations.description: Majority-smoothing passes over quantized levels; removes single-cell noise spikes.

minPlateauCells.title: Min Plateau Cells
minPlateauCells.description: Terraces covering fewer cells than this collapse into the surrounding level. 0 = off.

bumpMinSpacingCells.title: Bump Min Spacing Cells
bumpMinSpacingCells.description: Minimum distance between elevated bumps; closer bumps are suppressed. 0 = off.

maxBumpCount.title: Max Bump Count
maxBumpCount.description: Maximum elevated bumps kept per map; excess bumps collapse. 0 = unlimited.

ridgeErosionIterations.title: Ridge Erosion Iterations
ridgeErosionIterations.description: Passes that lower cells standing above all four neighbours; erodes spikes and knife ridges.

seedSalt.title: Seed Salt
seedSalt.description: Seed salt so relief does not correlate with layer masks sharing the map seed.

terrainRelief.title: Terrain Relief
terrainRelief.description: Deterministic 0.25 m terrace relief field; feeds terrain-level mask steps and per-cell surface heights.

stairThemeId.title: Stair Theme Id
stairThemeId.description: Atlas theme used for generated stair modules (e.g. stone).

stairTileId.title: Stair Tile Id
stairTileId.description: Semantic tile id written to stair cells.

moduleRiseMeters.title: Module Rise Meters
moduleRiseMeters.description: Rise covered by one stair module.

minLedgeDropMeters.title: Min Ledge Drop Meters
minLedgeDropMeters.description: Minimum ledge drop that receives a stair flight.

maxLedgeDropMeters.title: Max Ledge Drop Meters
maxLedgeDropMeters.description: Largest ledge drop a single flight may cover.

minEntranceSpacingCells.title: Min Entrance Spacing Cells
minEntranceSpacingCells.description: Minimum distance in cells between stair entrances along a ledge.

maxFlights.title: Max Flights
maxFlights.description: Maximum number of flights per map.

passages.title: Passages
passages.description: Generated stair passages across ledges (atlas pack contract).

anchorCount.title: Anchor Count
anchorCount.description: Number of seeded route anchor cells.

roadTileId.title: Road Tile Id
roadTileId.description: Tile/preset id used for primary route cells.

footpathTileId.title: Footpath Tile Id
footpathTileId.description: Tile/preset id used for secondary route cells.

overlaySurfaceOffsetMeters.title: Overlay Surface Offset Meters
overlaySurfaceOffsetMeters.description: Surface offset applied to route overlay tiles so they render above terrain.

heightPenaltyPerMeter.title: Height Penalty Per Meter
heightPenaltyPerMeter.description: Extra path cost per meter of height change; higher values keep roads on flat ground.

roadFraction.title: Road Fraction
roadFraction.description: Fraction of routes rendered as roads; the rest become footpaths.

seedSalt.title: Seed Salt
seedSalt.description: Seed salt so routes do not correlate with relief or layer masks.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Generated road/footpath routes between seeded anchors.

sinkLayerId.title: Sink Layer Id
sinkLayerId.description: Layer id whose final mask marks open water that rivers drain into. Evaluated before hydrology layers.

sinkMaxMeters.title: Sink Max Meters
sinkMaxMeters.description: Terrain at or below this height (meters) also counts as a sink. Covers the open-water sheet when no sink layer is set.

riverAccumulationThreshold.title: River Accumulation Threshold
riverAccumulationThreshold.description: Upstream drainage (in cells) a land cell needs to become a river.

riverMinSourceMeters.title: River Min Source Meters
riverMinSourceMeters.description: Minimum terrain height in meters for a river source cell.

riverMaxFraction.title: River Max Fraction
riverMaxFraction.description: Maximum river cells as a fraction of the map area.

lakeMinDepthMeters.title: Lake Min Depth Meters
lakeMinDepthMeters.description: Minimum flooded depth in meters for a depression to become a lake.

lakeMaxFraction.title: Lake Max Fraction
lakeMaxFraction.description: Maximum lake cells as a fraction of the map area.

waterSurfaceOffsetMeters.title: Water Surface Offset Meters
waterSurfaceOffsetMeters.description: Water surface offset in meters relative to the flooded level. Negative recesses water below banks.

waterfallMinDropMeters.title: Waterfall Min Drop Meters
waterfallMinDropMeters.description: Drop between a river cell and its downstream cell that marks a waterfall.

seedSalt.title: Seed Salt
seedSalt.description: Seed salt so hydrology does not correlate with relief or layer masks.

hydrology.title: Hydrology
hydrology.description: Deterministic rivers/lakes traced on the relief field; feeds hydrology mask steps.

shoreTileId.title: Shore Tile Id
shoreTileId.description: Semantic tile/preset id written to water-adjacent land cells.

shorePresetId.title: Shore Preset Id
shorePresetId.description: Preset id used for converted shore cells when no native shore layer exists. Defaults to ShoreTileId.

bandCells.title: Band Cells
bandCells.description: Land cells within this Chebyshev distance of water convert to the shore tile.

blendCells.title: Blend Cells
blendCells.description: Extra ring beyond the band that is only graded down toward the water without changing tile type.

shoreLiftMeters.title: Shore Lift Meters
shoreLiftMeters.description: Beach surface lift above the adjacent water surface in meters.

risePerCellMeters.title: Rise Per Cell Meters
risePerCellMeters.description: Maximum surface rise per cell of distance from water; caps the grading ramp.

maxDropToWaterMeters.title: Max Drop To Water Meters
maxDropToWaterMeters.description: Land cells whose surface exceeds water + lift by more than this stay untouched (cliff shoreline).

bandCoverage.title: Band Coverage
bandCoverage.description: Fraction of band cells converted to the shore tile; the rest keep their terrain but still grade toward the waterline. Below 1 the band reads as an irregular partial-tile strip.

seedSalt.title: Seed Salt
seedSalt.description: Seed salt so the coverage gate does not correlate with relief or layer masks.

waterTileIds.title: Water Tile Ids
waterTileIds.description: Extra winner tile ids counted as water for shore detection (e.g. 'swamp' tiles that render water but are not in shared WaterLikeTileIds). Shore-only: not skipped by relief/carve passes.

shore.title: Shore
shore.description: Recipe-authored shoreline planning. After relief is applied, land cells close to actual water are re-typed to the shore tile and graded down toward the neighbouring water surface so the waterline reads as a smooth continuous beach.
